quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
quests.passage: Despite living only a ten-minute walk from her office, Wren still drives to work most days because she often runs errands during her lunch break. On the rare days she does walk, she says she arrives feeling far more energized than usual.
quests.question: Wren drives to work most days.
quests.hint: Check how Wren usually gets to work.
quests.explanation: The passage confirms she drives most days, so this statement is true.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.

quests.instruction: Read the passage and determine if the statement is true or false.
